subject: Re: Project Saffron kickoff — LLMs as pattern machines
body:
Hi Priya,

Saffron staffing: Yusuf 60% (research lead), Emeka 40% (service prototype), Maren 40% (eval harness), Tereza 30% (robotics liaison).

Compute: this is inference-only against hosted models, so no cluster reservation — the cost is token spend. Budgeting 40M tokens for the replication sweep (the ARC-style ASCII prompts are long) and I have asked for a monthly cap alert at $8k so we notice runaway loops early.

Dependency: the released colabs assume external model APIs; Emeka is porting the prompting code to our internal serving endpoints first, ETA Mar 13.

Flag: context length limits will bind on the trajectory experiments — Yusuf is sizing how many CartPole episodes fit in-context.

Jelena
